cards.title: Mutter — archive 2001
cards.description: Flash animation for Mutter: a 2,260-frame intro animates the Rammstein logo and cross in green light, with a SKIP button.
cards.instructions: Mouse: click SKIP to leave the intro. No keyboard input is used (FFDec 26.2.1 full script export; scripts only contain the loading loop and an on(release) getURL to index.html).
cards.notes: Original file '2001 - Mutter.swf' (uncompressed FWS v4, 146,580 bytes); '2001' is the archive filename label, not a verified year, and no release date is embedded in the movie. The archive's 'Mutter/' decompiled export has 2,260 frames at 651x401, matching the SWF timeline; texts, scripts and images are preserved in assets/cards/2001-mutter/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Ich will
cards.description: Interactive Ich will visualizer: 1,031 frames at 45 fps in which cursor movement drives generative line drawings ('woistdieMaus', 'mausdelta') and a light mask over video stills. A status line in the movie announces 'RELEASE 10_09_2001'.
cards.instructions: Mouse: move the cursor across the stage; the animation reacts to pointer distance and to holding still. Buttons link to the single's send-to-a-friend form and a RealMedia sound file on the historical rammstein.de host (availability not verified).
cards.notes: Year 2001 is supported by the embedded text 'RELEASE 10_09_2001' (not by the archive filename label). The SWF was extracted byte-for-byte from the Flash projector '2001 - Ich will.exe' (uncompressed FWS v5 at offset 376,832; declared length 799,398 bytes); its 1,031 frames match the archive's 'Ich will/' export. The original EXE is preserved in originals/. Companion texts, scripts and images are in assets/cards/2001-ich-will/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Mutter — archive 2002
cards.description: German Mutter-era ecard/promo delivered inside a WinZip self-extracting EXE. The embedded projector SWF (1,077 frames, 12 fps) presents a specimen/DNA narrative (PRÄPARAT: CHRISTOPH S., TILL L., ...; DNA: XX00DRUMS/VOC; KODIERUNG: XXRAMM0.001; KONSERVIERUNG: JAN 2001), Mutter album/limited-edition panels, 2001 tour dates, an e-card form and links to the 'Sonne' video.
cards.instructions: Mouse: click the on-screen buttons; the full FFDec 26.2.1 script export contains only on(press), on(release) and on(rollOver) handlers and no key APIs. The 'Sonne' video was a RealMedia stream (rammstein.de/_mutter/sonne.ram and an rtsp:// URL) and the e-card form posted to php.rammstein.de; those historical endpoints are not verified.
cards.notes: '2002' is the archive filename label, not a verified year; embedded strings reference the 2001 Mutter album/tour, but no release date for the piece was found. The SWF was extracted from the inner ramm.exe (uncompressed FWS v5 at offset 376,832, 643,921 bytes) inside the outer WinZip SFX; the archive has no decompiled export, so 13 embedded JPEGs were recovered into assets/cards/2002-mutter/images/ and complete FFDec 26.2.1 script/text exports were added under scripts-ffdec/ and texts-ffdec/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Lichtspielhaus
cards.description: Lichtspielhaus DVD promo with an industrial console interface, trailer/video modules and a send-to-a-friend competition to win one of 20 original messenger bags.
cards.instructions: Mouse: navigate the console (trailer, back and module buttons). openvideo() expects extra modules in a relative flash/ directory (flash/trailer.swf, ...), which is not part of the supplied archive. Competition text is embedded ('DAS GEWINNSPIEL LÄUFT BIS ZUM 28.02.04'); no keyboard input is used.
cards.notes: This movie is labelled 2003 in the archive filename, but no verified release year was found; the only embedded date is the competition deadline 28.02.04. The SWF was extracted from '2003 - Lichtspielhaus.exe' (zlib CWS appended at offset 819,200; declared 1,282,417 bytes); its 498 frames match the archive's 'Lichtspielhaus/' export. Historical links point at ginza.se, motordiscs.de, virginiarecords.com and a motor.de form; their availability is not verified. The original EXE is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Reise, Reise
cards.description: Reise, Reise ecard: language selection, album information and a photo collage; frame 1 assigns a remote script path under universal-rock.de for the original ecard scripting.
cards.instructions: Mouse: choose a language, then use the on-screen navigation (START / AGB / IMP / FAQ / TOURDATES / SEND TO A FRIEND). No keyboard input is used.
cards.notes: Year 2004 is supported by embedded text: 'Das neue Album am 27. September 2004.' and the November/December 2004 tour-date lists. The SWF was extracted from '2004 - Reise, Reise.exe' (CWS appended at offset 819,200; declared 2,459,541 bytes); its 1,107 frames match the archive's 'Reise/' export. Embedded historical references include universal-rock.de ecard scripts and a frameloader URL; availability not verified. The original EXE is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Benzin Game
cards.description: French-language promotional driving game tied to the Rosenrot-era 'Benzin' release: drive a souped-up fire truck for 90 seconds, cause damage, hit cows and sheep for points, then submit a score, invite a friend or sign up for the newsletter.
cards.instructions: In-card French instructions (text 401): 'Au volant d'un véhicule de pompier sur-vitaminé tu as 1minute 30 pour faire un max de dégâts et gagner le plus de points possible !!'. Controls (texts 404–407): Arrow Up = 'Accélerer' (accelerate), Arrow Down = 'Freiner' (brake), Arrow Left = 'Tourner à gauche', Arrow Right = 'Tourner à droite'. Mouse is used for menus and forms.
cards.notes: Keyboard control is confirmed by the full FFDec 26.2.1 decompile (frame_10 sprite clip actions: Key.isDown(37/38/39/40)) and by the in-card control labels; the archive's own decompiled export was incomplete. '2005' is the archive filename label only: the intro artwork announces 'Nouvel album sortie le 28 octobre' without a year, so no verified year is claimed. Missing dependencies: relative benzin1.flv (NetStream video; movies/254.flv exported 0 bytes), listpays.xml and the acces/*.php score/form endpoints (historical, availability not verified); rammsteingame.artistes.universalmusic.fr/acces/hits.php is an embedded historical counter. An independent project in this workspace holds a byte-identical original.swf (SHA-256 d22a3d9f...1694249, retrieved from rammsteinworld.com with recorded checksum) and its reference decompile agrees with ours; no patched community SWF was copied over the original. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Keine Lust
cards.description: Keine Lust menu card (2 timeline frames with most content in sprites): intro, info, win, video, tour, screensaver and buy sections, plus a mailing-list sign-up that unlocks the full-length video stream.
cards.instructions: Mouse: click the menu items (INTRO / INFO / WIN / VIDEO / TOUR / SCREENSAVER / BUY). The sign-up form's Flash components also accept keyboard input (text entry, Enter/Space, arrow-key list navigation). Video streams load from the historical exodus.interoutemediaservices.com host and audio tracks from relative audio/trackN.mp3 files; availability is not verified.
cards.notes: '2005' is the archive filename label, not a verified year; no year-bearing embedded date was found. Full FFDec 26.2.1 export shows no gameplay keyboard use, but the generated Flash 6 form components (FComboBoxSymbol, FScrollSelectListSymbol, FRadioButtonSymbol, FCheckBoxSymbol, FUIComponentSymbol) handle Enter/Space/arrow keys inside the sign-up form. External dependencies include 12 exodus.interoutemediaservices.com video stream URLs and relative audio/trackN.mp3 files (not in the archive). Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Mann gegen Mann
cards.description: Mann gegen Mann single promo (541 frames at 25 fps) with dark painting/video imagery, a trailer and order/download links; German and English text exports are present.
cards.instructions: Mouse: use the on-screen links (INFO / VIDEO / SEND A FRIEND / RAMMSTEIN SHOP). No keyboard input is used. The trailer player uses the FLVPlayback component with an external skin (SteelExternalAll.swf) that is not in the archive.
cards.notes: Year 2006 is supported by embedded text: 'ab 03.03.06' (German) and 'out 03.03.06' (English); the archive filename label 2005 is not treated as a date. Missing dependencies: SteelExternalAll.swf (player skin), rammstein_22sec_clean.flv, and historical send-a-friend/newsletter endpoints under universal-rock.de and myprofile.universal-music.de; availability not verified. The original SWF is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Rosenrot
cards.description: Rosenrot ecard/promo built on the album's ship-in-ice imagery (297 frames at 31 fps) with a language-selection flow, wind ambience, sound loops and a link that loads the external rammstein_benzin.swf game.
cards.instructions: Mouse: choose a language and follow the on-screen controls; frame actions attach the 'windloop' and 'manngegemann' sounds. No keyboard input is used. The embedded 'Benzin' game link points at universal-rock.de and is not present in the archive.
cards.notes: Year 2005 is supported by embedded text describing live recordings from February, June and July 2005 (Rosenrot single track listing). The SWF was extracted from '2005 - Rosenrot.exe' (CWS appended at offset 819,200; declared 1,697,900 bytes); its 297 frames match the archive's 'Rosenrot/' export. External references include rammstein_benzin.swf, send2Friend/sendCoremailer scripts under universal-rock.de; availability not verified. The original EXE is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Rosenrot Single
cards.description: Rosenrot (Single) ecard (475 frames): preloader, uncensored-video announcement and an email form. The text promises video links to newsletter subscribers who signed up by 20 December 2005.
cards.instructions: Mouse: watch/click through; the send form (Email / send) posts to the historical coremailer.universal-music-group.com servlet. No keyboard input is used beyond form text entry.
cards.notes: Year 2005 is supported by embedded text: 'Subscribe to the Rammstein newsletter by 20 December 2005 and the links to the clip will be sent to you at once.' Embedded historical URLs include coremailer.universal-music-group.com and www.rammstein.de (content references, not provenance); availability not verified. The original SWF is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Völkerball
cards.description: Völkerball DVD microsite (899 frames): gold logo intro, gallery, password-protected preview, send-to-a-friend, contest and an edition overview (Standard / Special / Limited).
cards.instructions: Mouse: use the navigation (Replay / Info / Preview / Send / Win / Gallery / Download); gallery items load through switchGallery(). No keyboard input is used. The preview loads getFile.php?PW=<code> and the gallery expects relative wallpaper files (rst_voelkerball_wallpaper_*.jpg) that are not in the archive.
cards.notes: Year 2006 is supported by the embedded copyright line 'COPYRIGHT © 1997 - 2006 RAMMSTEIN & PILGRIM MANAGEMENT'; the SWF also carries RDF metadata with the title 'Rammstein - Völkerball' (no date). Historical endpoints include myprofile.universal-music.de and vertigo.fm (availability not verified). The original SWF is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: LIFAD
cards.description: Liebe ist für alle da promo (202 frames at 30 fps) presenting the album artwork and a link to the band website, with an embedded video stream.
cards.instructions: Mouse: click through the intro and the 'ZUR WEBSITE' link. No keyboard input is used.
cards.notes: '2009' is the archive filename label, not a verified year; no date-bearing text was found in the full FFDec 26.2.1 export. The only embedded URL is www.rammstein.de. Embedded video was exported as movies/7.flv (570,970 bytes); it is not copied to the repo. The original SWF is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.

cards.title: Pussy
cards.description: Pussy single promo (617 frames at 30 fps) with the single artwork and the video world premiere notice ('Video world premiere Pussy, Sep. 16th 2009 from 22:00 CET, exclusively on visit-x.net/rammstein'), plus Sound fade-in/out helpers.
cards.instructions: Mouse: click the on-screen prompts ('MORE', etc.). No keyboard input is used.
cards.notes: Year 2009 is supported by the embedded premiere text 'SEP. 16TH 2009'. Embedded historical URLs: www.visit-x.net/rammstein and www.rammstein.de/blog/lang/en/ (availability not verified). The original SWF is preserved in originals/. Not runtime-verified.
